review_findings: One case and one phase per process; no prior continuation test imported.
Production trainer/checkpoint loading unchanged; only final save callback hashes instead of serializing baseline/resumed state.
Partial checkpoint serialized directly to disk; no BytesIO or surviving serialized buffer.
Exact complete state equality required; per-parameter sampled scalar EMA recurrence is complementary, not all-element independent recurrence.
Original partial checkpoint SHA checked before/after deserialization; prior artifacts rechecked before/after every phase.
Existing process supervisor owns/reaps each child group; independent child watchdog includes STOP; no parent hard exit with live child.
All outputs retained; first failure stops entire fresh procedure, no retries.
